findings.summary: _landing_comment recognises a landing comment only by the c-close- prefix and otherwise quotes the last comment of the section, while the promotion path writes its landing comment as c-run-<run id> (RUN_COMMENT_PREFIX at reckon/crew/plan_review.py:252, written at reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:1447); for a promotion-landed section whose last comment is not its landing, the overview quotes unrelated prose as the section's landing line, and the tests only exercise the c-close- spelling.

_run_figures takes a plan_slug argument it never reads, and its only caller passes plan.get("slug") at reckon/evidence.py:404, so a parameter that implies the figure path is checked against the plan's directory does nothing and misleads the next reader.

_figure_src re-implements the project-absolute figure address that figure_row already owns as href = f"/{project}/figures/{slug}" at reckon/figures.py:171, without extending or importing that owner, so a change to the served figure route has two places to update.

_done_when truncates the section body at the first period, so a done-when carrying an abbreviation, an initial or a dotted path is quoted into the overview only up to that period, and the record states a partial done-when as the section's stated measure.

The section deliverable lists totals for 'review findings and their disposal' among what the overview must hold, and _totals_paragraph at reckon/evidence.py:794 renders runs, attempts and worker time only; the manifest records the reason in outside_scope (the ledger row drops findings, so a findings total needs a review-store read), so the clause is undelivered rather than wrong.

check_one_row_per_landed_node asserts nodes == ["s1-node", "s2-node"] and reads the attempts cell only for s1-node, so a renderer that emitted the correct row count with a wrong attempt count on s2-node would still pass; the third case's stated measure is attempts per node, and only one node's count is asserted.
